title: Second derivative formula
text: For a parametric curve, $$\frac{d2 y}{dx2}$$ is the derivative of $$\frac{dy}{dx}$$ with respect to $$t$$, divided by $$\frac{dx}{dt}$$.

title: Evaluate
text: The derivative of $$-\cot\theta$$ is $$\csc**2\theta$$ . Dividing by $$-4sin\left(\theta\right)$$ gives $$-\frac{1}{4\sin**3\theta}$$ . At $$theta=\frac{\pi}{4}$$ this equals $$\frac{-1}{\sqrt{2}}=\frac{-\sqrt{2}}{2}$$, so the curve is concave down.
